Hi Emily —

Thanks again for agreeing to be our guest speaker for the Feb 28 webinar, "LLMs in Clinical Decision Support." We want to lock the final run-of-show and confirm a couple of fallback options for the live demo in case of connectivity or infra hiccups.

Draft agenda (30 min total):
- 0:00–2:00 Intro + housekeeping (Karthik)
- 2:00–12:00 Emily talk: clinical use case + outcomes
- 12:00–22:00 Live demo + Q&A (moderated)
- 22:00–30:00 Closing and next steps

Two demo fallback options we propose:
1) Recorded demo video (2–3 min) hosted on Loom + quick screen-share if live demo fails.
2) Live canned dataset demo using a pre-provisioned VM in our staging region (we'll provide a short list of prompts).

Could you confirm: 1) you're comfortable with a short recorded demo if needed, and 2) any constraints on showing anonymized patient data or screenshots?

I'll attach the current slides and our demo-checklist for ops. Ava, can you add the tech checks and backup laptop plan? Laura, please confirm speaker arrival time on the day.

Thanks —
Karthik

Thanks for the agenda — looks tight and great. I can do a 10-minute focused demo on our model predicting risk stratification. I am fine with you using a 2–3 minute recorded version if the live demo stalls. We will only use de-identified example records; no PHI.

Two quick asks from my side: 1) Can you share the final slide where we list improvement metrics (AUC, precision)? I want to verify the figures. 2) If we're showing a live notebook, please hide any internal bucket names or identifiers.

Happy to record a short standby clip this week if that helps.
